data.name: Codex-Named Unit (trait_advanced_players_guide_apg_abilities_lst_232)
data.description: You know that all things pass in time, and are used to having to repeat arguments multiple times to convince even the most stubborn believer. You gain a +2 trait bonus on Diplomacy checks to influence hostile or unfriendly creatures, and if you fail at such an attempt, you may retry it once.
